reasoning_pattern_hint: Solve inequality via factor sign analysis
core_move_guess: Determine intervals where each factor is positive or negative.
mini_steps: Find roots of sin θ - cos θ = 0
Determine sign of each factor in intervals defined by roots
Identify intervals where product is non-negative
Calculate the length of the intervals
Divide by the total interval length (π)
wrong_move: Assuming that sin(2θ) - 1/2 and sin θ - cos θ must both be positive to satisfy the inequality, or only considering one factor.
